title: Morning rush in Toronto: every train, 6:30 to 9:30 am
description:
The morning rush in Toronto, 6:30 to 9:30 am, in 25 seconds. Every train inside the city on an average October weekday.

The timetables are from October 2026. I kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays and placed each vehicle by its schedule. Vehicles outside the Toronto city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Line 1, Line 2, GO, Line 5, Line 6, Line 4 and UP.

Busiest moment of the morning: 168 trains at 8:17 am.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Thanksgiving (October 12).
